## Batch Transform (BT)

Every item goes through the SAME single-writer command the one-at-a-time path uses (Assign Owner / Run Workflow / Archive Record) — a batch can never do what the individual action could not. PER-ITEM RESULTS always: a refused item is reported with its rule, never silently skipped, and one refusal does not stop the rest.

### Non-goals

No transactionality (the platform has none — the per-item report is the honest contract); no querying (the selection is caller-loaded).

The linked examples are two open cases, the kind of selection a queue hands to Batch Transform to reassign or move through the support workflow together.
